template.character.label: Character
template.character.description: Heroes, villains, rulers and wandering bards. Track their house, status and the seats they hold.
template.playerCharacter.label: Player Character
template.playerCharacter.description: The heroes at your table: who plays them, their class and level, their quests, their party and the legacy they leave.
template.organization.label: Organization
template.organization.description: Noble houses, guilds, councils and secret orders, and the people who swear by them.
template.territory.label: Territory
template.territory.description: Empires, kingdoms, duchies and marches, arranged into the hierarchy that rules your world.
template.settlement.label: Settlement
template.settlement.description: Cities, towns, villages and outposts: who lives there, what they trade, what they fear.
template.building.label: Building
template.building.description: Castles, taverns, temples and ruins worth a detailed floor plan and a whispered rumor.
template.geography.label: Geography
template.geography.description: Mountains, rivers, forests and seas: the land itself, its dangers and its secrets.
template.military.label: Military
template.military.description: Armies, fleets, legions and warbands: who commands them, how they fight, and where they march.
template.conflict.label: Conflict
template.conflict.description: Wars, sieges, rebellions and feuds: their causes, their battles and the scars they leave.
template.technology.label: Technology
template.technology.description: Machines, techniques and inventions, how they work, and who would kill to control them.
template.title.label: Title
template.title.description: Crowns, ranks and honors: how they are earned, inherited, and stolen.
template.law.label: Law
template.law.description: Edicts, codes and customs of justice, and the price of breaking them.
template.tradition.label: Tradition
template.tradition.description: Festivals, rites of passage and old habits that bind a people together.
template.culture.label: Culture
template.culture.description: Art, language, cuisine and values: what makes a people who they are.
template.species.label: Species
template.species.description: Peoples, beasts and monsters: their origins, their nature, and how to survive them.
template.fauna.label: Fauna
template.fauna.description: Animals of the wild and the farm: where they roam, what they eat, and what people make of them.
template.flora.label: Flora
template.flora.description: Trees, herbs, fungi and stranger growths: where they grow, what they heal, and what they poison.
template.monster.label: Monster
template.monster.description: Creatures to fear: their lairs, their habits, their legends, and a link to their stat block.
template.religion.label: Religion
template.religion.description: Gods, pantheons, cults and faiths, with their tenets, clergy and holy sites.
template.item.label: Item
template.item.description: Legendary blades, cursed relics and humble heirlooms with a story to tell.
template.magic.label: Magic & Spells
template.magic.description: Spells, rituals, schools and traditions of magic: how they’re cast, and what they cost.
template.generic.label: Generic
template.generic.description: A blank page for anything that doesn’t fit elsewhere: lore notes, session recaps, loose ideas.
template.document.label: Document
template.document.description: Letters, prophecies, treaties and in-world texts your players can find and read.
template.language.label: Language
template.language.description: Tongues, dialects, scripts and secret cants: who speaks them, and what they unlock.
